newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus calls MD talk "pure speculation".
newsitem.headline: Airbus calls MD talk "pure speculation".

text.p: European plane making consortium Airbus Industrie said on Thursday a report in Germany's Die Welt newspaper saying Hartmut Mehdorn could become the new managing director was pure speculation.
"That is pure speculation," a company spokesman said from corporate headquarters in Toulouse.

"It is well known that Mr Pierson's mandate, at his request, will end in April. Airbus is not talking to any candidates for succession, that is a matter for the owners, the partner companies," he added.

Die Welt said that Mehdorn, currently head of Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG and a former Daimler-Benz Aerospace executive, would become amanaging director while Pierson would take the chair on the supervisory board.
Former Daimler-Benz head Edzard Reuter is currently chairman of the supervisory board at Airbus.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
Aerospatiale and Deutsche Airbus have 38 pct each. British Aerospace Plc has 20 pct and CASA of Spain four pct.
